defects: (a) THE NAVIGATOR'S, ON THE AUTHOR'S WORD: A REMOTE RUNNER SENT AFTER REFS THAT LIVED ON ONE HOST. (R263)(4) dispatched the runner at the two branches and said nothing of pushing them; both were local only, and both first runs failed at the checkout step before any build or artifact, "upload-pack: not our ref" (SIDE-lv-conservation run 38197369344 at c35a3a31...; SIDE-kernel run 38197387315 at ee8d21a1...). Raised to the author; the author's word: the navigator's, not the seat's -- the seat dispatched as ruled. The two branches pushed to origin under their own names, no main touched, each read back by ls-remote at its tip; one further dispatch per branch at the same SHA (runs 38197669258 and 38197671140). The branches stay at the remote until merged, then are deleted in the house form after --merged lists them.

(b) THE SEAT'S: A PUSH RUN IN ANOTHER REPOSITORY'S WORKING DIRECTORY. Two pushes were issued as parallel calls; the second, for docstrings-SIDE-kernel, ran in SIDE-lv-conservation's directory and failed there with "src refspec does not match any" -- nothing pushed; re-run with git -C on SIDE-kernel and read back.

(c) THE SEAT'S: A WORKFLOW'S HEADER COMMENT READ AS A TERMINAL. The runner route took every line of the workflow file containing "#print axioms " as a named terminal; the file's header comment names the command, and the T3 gate first read 9 terminals, 8 DERIVES and one UNREAD, NOT DERIVES. Caught on the first reading, before any merge; the route takes only lines that begin with the command, and read 8 of 8.

(d) THE SEAT'S: A PRIMED NAME CUT AT ITS QUOTE. The print pattern took a name as the characters up to the first quote, so Voice7Witness.hadamard_does_not_enforce_online' read UNREAD and SIDE-kernel's gate first read 53 of 54; caught on the first reading, before any merge; the pattern takes the name to the quote before " depends" or " does not", and read 54 of 54.

(e) THE SEAT'S: THE LOCAL-LEAN READING CAUGHT ITS AUTHOR'S COMMIT MESSAGES. The commands route's pattern (N1) read the whole command text, and the two workflow commits (#43, #44 of the capture) name `lake exe cache get` in their -m messages: the bank first read 2 local lean or lake commands where none ran. Caught on the bank's first reading, before the face; the record tool reads the pattern outside quoted strings (local_lean, its controls: `lake build Kernel.Core` and `cd x && lake exe cache get` read, a quoted message and a '*.lean' pathspec do not), the suite calls the same function, and the bank reads 0.

(f) THE SEAT'S: THE STEP-ZERO CENSUSES WRITTEN WITH CARRIAGE RETURNS.The three censuses and pins taken before the lock gate were redirected from the tools' stdout in the shell, and their working copies carried CR LF (31, 17 and 43 line ends, no lone CR) while git committed them LF at the seal; caught before the root, which names them: each rewritten LF, its blob id read equal to the sealed commit's, and the root read none written CR LF.
short: (a) the navigator's, on the author's word: a remote runner sent after refs that lived on one host
(b) the seat's: a push run in another repository's working directory
(c) the seat's: a workflow's header comment read as a terminal
(d) the seat's: a primed name cut at its quote
(e) the seat's: the local-lean reading caught its author's commit messages
(f) the seat's: the step-zero censuses written with carriage returns
